needs_manual_review_reason: Adjacent-scope per docs/scope.md: live GEO record (verified directly via acc.cgi) confirms Series_overall_design describes NF2-deficient CH-157MN meningioma cells (an established human meningioma cell line, not primary patient tissue) with doxycycline-inducible WT-Merlin, injected subcutaneously into NU/NU mouse flanks; per-GSM inspection (GSM7020145-GSM7020156) confirms exactly 5 'Merlin-deficient' (no doxycycline) and 7 'Merlin rescue' (200ug/ml doxycycline) tumors, matching the series summary's '5 Merlin-deficient tumors and seven Merlin rescue tumors' verbatim; sample_source_name for all 12 samples is literally 'Human cells in mouse xenograft'. Series_sample_organism lists both Homo sapiens and Mus musculus (platform GPL25526 explicitly titled for both organisms), consistent with scRNA-seq of a xenograft capturing both human tumor cells and mouse host-derived cells; reference_genome left 'Not reported' since no specific combined genome build/version is stated on the live record. Two PubMed IDs are listed on the series (36993679, 39251601): PubMed's own 'Update in' cross-reference confirms 36993679 is the March 2023 Research Square preprint of the same work, later published as the peer-reviewed Nature Communications paper (39251601, Eaton et al. 2024); both are represented here as a single publications entry (peer-reviewed version with preprint_id populated), consistent with this corpus's existing PXD053578 companion record for the same underlying study. who_edition/patient_count use the established 'Not applicable (cell line)'-style convention for non-patient-tissue model systems (no separate PDX/xenograft enum exists in docs/controlled_vocabulary.md).
